title: After-Hours Installation Premium — Homeowner Service Contracts Replacements
content:
Contractor pay bulletin, Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts. On a replacement Bridgewell authorizes after a stalled repair, an after-hours installation charge pays the contractor's premium for installing in the visit window the customer asked for on the stalled request:

| Visit window asked for on the stalled request | Tier's after-hours surcharge on a non-emergency request | After-hours installation charge |
|---|---|---|
| after-hours | zero (the customer paid no surcharge) | 90.00 |
| after-hours | above zero | 45.00 |
| business-hours | any | nothing |

The tier's after-hours surcharge on a non-emergency request:

| Bridgewell ApplianceCare | Bridgewell SystemsCare | Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze | Bridgewell HomeCare Silver | Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 0.00 |

The charge is added to the stalled-repair replacement cost as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, and the cost so obtained is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits without being rounded first.

*Hypothetical cases:* an after-hours visit asked for on Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum, whose surcharge is 0.00: 90.00. An after-hours visit asked for on Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze: 45.00. A business-hours visit on any tier: nothing.
